pitchEn: A personal daily assistant that runs a morning briefing (weather for several of your cities with sharp-change warnings, your agenda and motivation), fires reminders for medication, habits and tasks, and gives an optional evening summary. Dictate a task in any of 15 languages — the robot notes it like a secretary and reads it back aloud on the day. Everything stays on the device.
newFeaturesEn: Voice task input: dictate WHEN and the TASK in any of 15 languages; the robot schedules it and reads it aloud on the day. Multi-city morning weather with afternoon/evening change warnings. Streamlined 3-step setup. Speech recognition runs on the device; nothing is uploaded.

dataHandling.notes: Microphone is used ONLY for optional on-device speech-to-text when the user taps the mic to dictate a reminder/task; the audio is transcribed on the device and never uploaded or stored. Network is used only to fetch weather from a public service by a city NAME the user types (no GPS/device location). Text-to-speech uses the device speaker. Reminders, notes and settings are stored locally; local notifications only, no account, no cloud.

reviewerRemarksEn: No account or login is required. On first launch pick a language and activate the robot, then grant the notification permission. Setup is 3 steps: 1) morning briefing time + add cities for weather (by name, no GPS); 2) tasks & reminders — you can type them or tap the mic to DICTATE (on-device speech recognition, so it asks for microphone once); 3) allow notifications. The dictated text is read back aloud on the day via on-device text-to-speech. Internet is used only for weather lookups by city name; location/GPS is never accessed; microphone is used only while dictating and audio is never uploaded.
